local_services: run-owned temporary ComfyUI using existing aki-v2 target read-only

target_roots.runtime_base: run-owned temporary directory outside repository and target roots

required_preconditions: project owner confirms GPU usage has been released before approval
executed candidate and harness equal bound SHA values
fresh live-05 evidence destination is absent and atomically reserved
Windows-native and WSL GPU samples agree within 128 MiB and max used memory is <=4096 MiB before service start
no target process or listener on 8191/11434
OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD true with zero nonloopback connections for >=10 seconds and >=5 samples
exact local gemma4:26b exists without download
required public class types exist before image attempt
required_checks: drive hash-bound image through real public /prompt and /history owners
prove raw/suggestion separation, no automatic draft write and explicit adopt epoch increment
exercise manual CPU route after owned Ollama stop
persist minimized parseable evidence including aggregate GPU preflight context on stop
prove per-call unload, /api/ps empty, owned-only cleanup, empty ports, removed temp and unchanged target fingerprints
leave fixed product cases NOT_RUN pending independent review
mandatory_stops: candidate, harness, target, model, sample, run ID or evidence destination mismatch
identity, GPU, process, port, no-cloud or nonloopback gate failure
GPU prestart used memory exceeds 4096 MiB or runtime reaches 23552 MiB
public route, registry, semantic Oracle or state-isolation failure
evidence serialization, minimization or write failure
unload, cleanup, target integrity or privacy gap
forbidden: downloads, upgrades or permanent target writes
contract, denominator, owner, Oracle, timeout or threshold changes
reuse of prior evidence or authorization
evidence_minimization: persist aliases, hashes, aggregate counts, aggregate GPU context, authorized listener IDs and whitelisted stable diagnostics only; never persist media bytes, tensors/current_inputs, traceback, private paths, unrelated process tables or command lines
cleanup: unload every model call, require terminal /api/ps empty, re-prove listener ownership, stop run-owned PIDs, prove ports empty, remove run-owned paths and prove target fingerprints unchanged
expires_when: one terminal WP-S1-03 live-05 receipt is generated, the single effective image attempt is consumed, or any mandatory stop occurs
